transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to close out the twenty-four drums of solvent waste from the recent line-cleaning operation before our temporary storage permit expires on Friday. As part of our waste-closeout review, I need Jon to present the current laboratory and waste-log information for these drums, and Priya to present the current batch-genealogy and hold information. Once I have those records in front of me, we can determine the appropriate disposition and record our decision on the closeout form.

transcript.text: I received the laboratory classification report yesterday. 15 drums meet the approved solvent-recovery specification, 3 drums fail the water-content limit and must go to hazardous-waste incineration, and the remaining 6 drums were not classified in that report. A laboratory-system outage kept the report from being uploaded to the waste log.

transcript.text: I've completed my batch-genealogy review. The 6 unclassified drums are from lot VX-204 — they contain residual catalyst and must be retained on site for exactly 30 days for possible process investigation rather than sent for treatment. I should note that the hold tags haven't been entered in the production system yet, but the review itself is complete and I can present the findings now.
